summary: Iteration 16 tested backend+frontend for managed shop/coach/courses scope. Backend regression for shop RBAC, creator/admin moderation, payout atomicity, and coach privacy passed 10/10 via isolated fixtures against public preview URL. Frontend mobile checks loaded and auth flows worked, but full RevenueCat purchase E2E in web preview could not be fully validated due onboarding/route interference during scripted navigation (loop-prevention reached after 3 selector-script attempts). Account isolation was partially validated in UI: nonna did not inherit coach access/history and coach remained locked.

ui_bugs.component: Shop entry/navigation from direct /shop URL in web preview
ui_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /shop during automation repeatedly landed on Oggi/onboarding context (visible testIDs: oggi-shop, tab-oggi...), so coach offer testIDs were not consistently reachable in-script. This blocked full cancel/success/restore purchase-path assertions in this run.

integration_issues.flow: RevenueCat end-to-end in web preview (identity log -> cancel -> success -> restore -> manage)
integration_issues.issue: Not fully verified in this run due repeated navigation/onboarding interference and loop-prevention cap after 3 script attempts. RevenueCat web mode console appears, but final store-package/entitlement transition assertions are incomplete.

action_items: Main agent: stabilize mobile web navigation into Shop during automation (e.g., deterministic route guard bypass after onboarding) so coach purchase testIDs are always reachable.
Main agent: re-run focused UI E2E for RevenueCat test-store path (cancel -> success -> restore -> manage) once Shop route access is stable.
Main agent: optional code hardening - avoid env defaults for sensitive config in backend (ADMIN_EMAIL fallback in shop.py and similar), per fail-fast env policy.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/shop.py sets ADMIN_EMAIL with a hardcoded fallback default; this conflicts with strict env-only fail-fast policy and can hide misconfiguration.
backend tests confirm admin guard is correctly session-verified (identity_verified + verified_email + current user email), and password-like session for owner email is denied as required.
Course privacy controls behaved correctly: non-preview lesson content is redacted for students; preview progress only is enforced; creator cannot edit published course without withdrawal.

success_rate.frontend: 55% (core auth/load/isolation partial pass; full RC purchase E2E incomplete)

seed_data_creation: Created isolated fixture users/sessions/applications/earnings with unique it16_* tag directly in test DB for RBAC/moderation/payout checks; cleanup included in fixture teardown. Coach UI test created one unique message token candidate but message send was blocked by subscription lock in UI path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not rework selectors repeatedly: 3 attempts already used for this UI flow. Start from Oggi and tap testID oggi-shop to enter Shop instead of direct /shop navigation; handle onboarding 'Salta' first. Then verify coach-offer package price (expected €4.99), identity-binding console line, and cancel/success/restore/manage path.
rca_of_issue: Frontend automation blocker RCA: app state often enters onboarding/Oggi shell after auth; direct route jumps were not deterministic under web preview. As a result, revenuecat components under /shop were intermittently unavailable. Reproduction: login -> navigate /shop -> observe Oggi testIDs + onboarding controls rather than coach-offer nodes. Mitigation: deterministic post-login route transition via in-app 'Oggi Shop' action (testID oggi-shop), and onboarding dismissal pre-step in scripts.
